implementation.read: Current scoped read permission and expiry checked per private host call. Linked inodes refresh metadata/references. Detached files retain last-observed immutable references and report nlink zero. Public _boxes_io.call rejects the private namespace.
implementation.lifetime: Each private host operation releases its filesystem kernel in its own native Effect scope. Descriptors, buffered bytes and decoder state use existing R2 native heap packs.
implementation.stdlib: Pinned unchanged io/_pyio/stat modules, native _io buffers/codecs, lazy open binding installation and explicit interpreter UTF-8 mode.
implementation.requestSchema: The combined native filesystem request Schema is created once per Worker, preserving its parser identity across host calls.
